We provide intuitions behind this odd and surprising behavior, as well as extensive empirical analyses quantifying the effect of various parameters. For instance, for larger model sizes we observe higher waywardness, i.e, we can find prompts that more closely map to any arbitrary text with a smaller drop in accuracy. \[
\text{Volumetric Flow Rate} = \text{Velocity} \times \text{Cross-sectional Area}
\]

Given:
- Velocity (\(v\)) = 2 m/s
- Cross-sectional Area (\(A\)) = 5 m²

Now, plug in the values:

\[
\text{Volumetric Flow Rate} = 2 \, \text{m/s} \times 5 \, \text{m}^2 = 10 \, \text{m}^3/\text{s}
\]

So, the volumetric flow rate is \(10 \, \text{m}^3/\text{s}\).
